name: Timeline
tagline: Dates and milestones go in, a fast story told one milestone at a time comes out.
description: A 20–60 second story of how something got here: a company, a product, a person or a year. Each milestone gets its own beat with a big year or number, a headline of a few words and one simple picture, and a progress bar moves along as time passes. Good for origin stories, anniversaries, year-in-review posts and biographies.
bring: The milestones with their dates, or a source to pull them from (an about page, a CV, a changelog)
Optional: photos, logos or screenshots for some milestones
Optional: music you have the rights to, or a voice recording
get: A 20–60 s video (16:9, or 9:16 on request) with music, ending on a closing card

needs.name: Hyperframes (or your project's video tool), Python 3 and ffmpeg
Voice, timing and sound scripts (from the Explainer playbook)

featuredStyles.note: A documentary look for histories and origin stories: each milestone as an engraved drawing on parchment under sunburst rays, the year as a big serif counter. Build every milestone in it as the style's guide says; keep this playbook's beat structure and progress bar.

steps: Pick 5–9 milestones and check every date against a source
Write a big year or number and a short headline for each
Draw one simple picture per milestone
Time the beats to the music or the voice and animate them
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
